irregularities.summary: Band 12 (det_elev) spans [-590.0, +1470.0] m (median -75.58 m), representing detrended local elevation above regional base rather than raw ASL elevation (~1,335 m Lake Lahontan highstand). Additionally, 3,061 footprint pixels (3,073 in Band 06) carry float32 -3.4028235e+38 sentinels in raw training_features.tif.

irregularities.summary: Prior user submission failed DrivenData validation with 'Predicted values must be in range [0, 1]'. Historical *-nan.tif files store NaN outside the 5,167,373-cell footprint (7,111,787 outer cells), and raw Band 1..19 rasters contain -3.4028e+38 float32 sentinels.
irregularities.resolution: Emitted strictly '-zeros.tif' (nodata=None, 0.0 outside footprint, 12,279,160 / 12,279,160 finite float32 pixels in [0.0, 1.0]), verified saved bytes on disk via 13-check audit_geotiff, and removed the diagnostic -nan.tif file from docs/downloads/ so it can never be uploaded by mistake.

irregularities.summary: Across all 104 audited repositories (2,148 rasters, 1,793 unique SHA-256s), 13GEMSDOE contains synthetic space-filling 5-px lattices (r13-lattice-s5, 206,895 dots covering 99.8713% of the valid footprint within 3 px; pigeonhole lower bound >=82.34% for any 37,654-dot mask), and WBGGEMSDOE1/WBGGEMSDOE2/GEMSDOEkarage2 contain >5.1M-pixel continuous research surfaces (100% off-catalogue positive support).
irregularities.resolution: Reported BOTH discrete-candidate 3-px overlap across all 1,577 discrete rasters (max 66.27% <= 70%, PASS; max 65.05% across all 9 focus sites, PASS) AND literal/null-calibrated overlap + Spearman rank correlation (max |Spearman| = 0.6525 <= 0.90 across all 1,789 grid-compatible rasters) with zero silent exemptions.

irregularities.summary: Unsupervised physical CRSB-GUB (EXP-1) beats the 0.2778 Champion on off-catalogue SGMC-CAL-v3.0 (0.067889 vs 0.064121, +0.003768) while scoring 0.048178 on HIDE-RECOVER-v3.0; Dual-Cover OOF + MaxEnv (EXP-3) beats the 0.2778 Champion in point HIDE-RECOVER-v3.0 (0.106042 vs 0.099202, +0.006840, 93.1% win prob, paired 95% CI [-0.002006, +0.016383]) while scoring 0.057360 on SGMC-CAL-v3.0.
irregularities.resolution: Fails closed to verdict='negative' (ok_to_submit=false) per promotion_gate.py and Protocol Rule 6 rather than spending a weekly submission slot without statistically conclusive dual-benchmark dominance.

irregularities.summary: The supplied prompt cites both 0.3195 and 0.4413 as competition leaderboard highs, and lists nine site scores (0.2449..0.2778) without portal receipt screenshots. Outbound network whitelist allows GitHub and PyPI/npm only (DrivenData, USGS, GDR, Dropbox, NLR unreachable directly).
irregularities.resolution: Preserved both 0.3195 and 0.4413 verbatim as unverified prompt claims, labeled all nine historical site scores as OWNER-REPORT (distinct from measured HOLDOUT-DTI), and verified all local rasters via SHA-256 against pinned GitHub mirrors.

irregularities.summary: Focus-file scores 0.2449-0.2778 are user-reported with no organizer receipt. All nine files pass the local [0,1] check, so the 'Predicted values must be in range [0, 1]' error is not caused by out-of-range values. NaN outside the footprint is allowed by the official spec, so it is not a confirmed cause. Real cause unverified.
